fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head and drove it by hand in a scratch repo (bare origin, fake gh answering pr view as PR #7 green). rhiza ship check with no RHIZA_RUN left the ship record's run unset; RHIZA_RUN=runA ship check wrote run=runA; RHIZA_RUN=runA ship land pushed and kept run=runA; RHIZA_RUN=runB ship check --change switched it to run=runB; a later ship check with no RHIZA_RUN kept runB; after main moved, RHIZA_RUN=runC ship rebase pushed, cleared head and wrote run=runC. internal/run/engine.go sets RHIZA_RUN for every step. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShip.*Run|TestShipLand|TestWatchdogPRNoCI' passes (with the inherited RHIZA_ROOT unset).
